name: tag-input
title: Tag Input
description: Chip field for a string[] value with suggestions, paste batching, and max tags.

api.description: Chip field for a string[] value with optional suggestions, paste batching, max tags, and reject feedback.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the tag list changes.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Suggestion list filtered against the draft and existing tags.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid styling and aria-invalid on the combobox.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder when there are no tags. Defaults to the string catalogue.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Applied on the root wrapper, not the combobox input. Prefer a visible Label with htmlFor pointing at id so the combobox itself is named.

props.name: itemChrome
props.description: Default List Item chrome for suggestion rows.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called when a commit is rejected. Duplicate also plays a short shake.

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: Combobox (role="combobox"): The draft input is a combobox with list autocomplete. Arrow keys move the active suggestion; Enter commits the active suggestion or the draft; Escape closes the list; Backspace on an empty draft removes the last chip. Chip remove (button): Each chip remove control uses a catalogue aria-label that includes the tag text. Accessible name (Label htmlFor): Wire a visible Label with htmlFor matching id. The aria-label prop names the root wrapper only, so Label plus id is the reliable way to name the combobox.
